REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JULY 14, 2022 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
* COVID-19 NOTICE *
To protect public health and safety during the COVID-19 pandemic and in compliance with the current State Department of Public Health and Los Angeles County Health Officer Orders and City of Cerritos COVID-19 Safety Plan, the City Council Chamber will be open to the public. As authorized by State of California Executive Orders N-25-20, N-29-20, and N-08-21, and subsequently by Assembly Bill 361 (Chapter 165, Statutes of 2021) and City Council Resolution No. 2022-10 adopted pursuant thereto, this meeting may also be conducted via teleconference, if necessary. Public observation and participation in this meeting will be facilitated through the methods described below.
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in-person in the Council Chamber subject to posted COVID-19 protocols.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in-person at the meeting or by using the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

Report from City Manager/Executive Director
During this part of the meeting the City Manager/Executive Director or designated staff will have an opportunity to report on various City matters and/or respond verbally to questions or comments from the prior City Council meeting, including any request by the City Council to provide a brief supplemental report or brief follow-up response to items from the prior City Council meeting’s agenda.
11B.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Meeting Reports
During this part of the meeting members of the City Council report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports concerning committees on which the Councilmembers serve and reports on meetings/conferences attended. In addition, requests may be made of the staff for reports which will be presented to the City Council at a subsequent meeting, or for the scheduling of future agenda items. There will be no discussion or action taken on any of the items that may be presented during this agenda item.
12.
Closed Session
Closed Session Report
If the City Council adjourns to Closed Session, the City Council/Successor Agency will reconvene into Open Session after its conclusion and designated City staff will provide a verbal report on any reportable action taken. This report will be memorialized in the official meeting minutes.
13.
Adjournment

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD THURSDAY,
JULY 14, 2022, 7:00 P.M., IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Chuong Vo.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Lynda P. Johnson
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Bruce Barrows
  Mayor/Chair Chuong Vo

5.  Presentations/Appointments

5A.  Presentations

  None.

5B.  Review and consideration of the 2022-2024 City Council appointments to the Cerritos
  Advisory Boards (Commissions and Committees) (COUNCIL).

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to provide public comment, the Mayor declared the public comments period
  closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Solanki, to approve Mayor Pro
  Tem Barrows’ nomination, as listed below, for a two-year term of service, commencing
  July 14, 2022 and expiring April 30, 2024 (COUNCIL):

  Name  Advisory Board
  Kelly Colwell*  Fine Arts and Historical Commission
  *This action creates an unscheduled vacancy on the Community Safety Committee
  which will be posted in accordance with the California Government Code for 10 working
  days prior to Council action to fill the position at a noticed public meeting.

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Solanki, Yokoyama, Barrows, Vo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, July 14, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 2 of 7

5.  Presentations/Appointments (continued)

5C.  Informational update on the City’s response to the COVID-19 pandemic and other City
  events, services, and programs.

  An informational update was given by Annie Hylton, City Librarian & Marketing Manager. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  There was no action taken on this item.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Katherine George Chu spoke regarding an upcoming youth speech and art contest. The
  speaker submitted a document for the record entitled, “Youth Speech & Art Contest.”
  (Documents submitted during public comments are considered for public records and are
  available by request in the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer)

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to provide public comment, the
  Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Thursday, June 23, 2022, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting
  Minutes (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Johnson, to approve the Thursday,
  June 23, 2022, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Solanki, Yokoyama, Barrows, Vo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands

7B.1. Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated July 14, 2022 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Johnson, to approve the Register of
  Demands as follows:

  City of Cerritos  July 14, 2022  $ 8,607,813.54 (COUNCIL)

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Solanki, Yokoyama, Barrows, Vo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, July 14, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 3 of 7

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7C.  Waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  CERRITOS AUTHORIZING SUBMITTAL OF APPLICATIONS FOR ALL CALRECYCLE GRANT
  AND PAYMENT PROGRAMS FOR WHICH THE CITY OF CERRITOS IS ELIGIBLE (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Johnson, to waive full reading of
  and adopt Resolution No. 2022-30, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF
  THE CITY OF CERRITOS AUTHORIZING SUBMITTAL OF APPLICATIONS FOR ALL
  CALRECYCLE GRANT AND PAYMENT PROGRAMS FOR WHICH THE CITY OF
  CERRITOS IS ELIGIBLE (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Solanki, Yokoyama, Barrows, Vo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Review and consideration of the City of Cerritos 2022 Public Health Goals Report
  (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Sergio Huizar, Management Analyst. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and the public comments period. Noting there
  were no individuals who elected to provide public comment, the Mayor declared the
  public comments period and the public hearing closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Yokoyama, and seconded by Johnson, to direct staff to send
  confirmation to the regulatory agencies that the City of Cerritos 2022 Public Health
  Goals Report has been completed and a public hearing has been held (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Solanki, Yokoyama, Barrows, Vo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of an amendment to an existing lease agreement for the
  extension of lease terms between the City of Cerritos and Lou Sobh Cerritos Saturn,
  Incorporated, dba Kia of Cerritos, for real property located at 18201 Studebaker Road,
  Cerritos, California, 90703 (APN 7034-017-910) (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kristin Aguila, Director of Community Development. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to provide public comment, the Mayor declared the public comments period
  closed.
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, July 14, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 4 of 7

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9A.  (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Johnson, and seconded by Barrows, to authorize the City
  Manager, or his designee, to execute the appropriate documents to facilitate and
  consent to the execution of the ground lease amendment, in such form as the City
  Attorney shall deem appropriate (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (3 – 2) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Barrows, Vo
  NOES:  Solanki, Yokoyama
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9B.  Review and consideration of the 2022-23 Mayor’s annual appointment recommendations
  for City Council and community member service on external boards, commissions, and
  committees and ad hoc working groups (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer. A PowerPoint presentation
  was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to provide public comment, the Mayor declared the public comments period
  closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Johnson, and seconded by Solanki, to:

  1.  Approve the formation of the following two (2) new ad hoc working groups, with
  the listed Councilmember liaisons, including determination of the general scope
  and scale of each ad hoc working group, and with Councilmember liaison terms
  concluding at the end of the current Mayor's term in 2023:

  Ad Hoc Working Group Name  Councilmember
  Liaisons
  Community Garden  Vo, Johnson
  Disaster Preparedness/Emergency Management  Vo, Barrows

  ; and

  a.  Update the 2022-23 Mayor’s Annual Appointments List accordingly (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Solanki, Yokoyama, Barrows, Vo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9C.  Review and consideration of a transfer agreement with the Los Angeles County Flood
  Control District to provide the City of Cerritos Safe, Clean Water Program (Measure W)
  funding for the design of a regional stormwater capture project at the Cerritos Sports
  Complex (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Mike O’Grady, Utilities Administrator. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, July 14, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 5 of 7

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9C.  (continued)

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to provide public comment, the Mayor declared the public comments period
  closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Solanki, to approve and authorize the
  City Manager to enter into the transfer agreement for $2,408,000, as well as any required
  addendums, with the Los Angeles County Flood Control District, in substantially the same
  form as submitted, for the design of a regional stormwater capture project at the Cerritos
  Sports Complex (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Solanki, Yokoyama, Barrows, Vo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9D.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS IMPLEMENTING EMERGENCY WATER
  CONSERVATION REGULATIONS (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Sergio Huizar, Management Analyst. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Case van der Linden spoke in support of the implementation of emergency water
  conservation regulations.

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to provide public comment, the
  Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Barrows, to waive full reading of and
  adopt Resolution No. 2022-31, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF CERRITOS IMPLEMENTING EMERGENCY WATER CONSERVATION
  REGULATIONS (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Solanki, Yokoyama, Barrows, Vo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9E.  Review and consideration by the Cerritos City Council of a proposal submitted by
  Government Technology Group (GTG) to prepare a feasibility study and cost-benefit
  analysis relative to the proposed development and implementation of a Citywide
  broadband fiber optic master plan for local economic development and revenue
  generating purposes, RFP No. 1452-22, in the amount of $74,685 (COUNCIL).

  Pursuant to Section 15262, Feasibility and Planning Studies, of the California
  Environment Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from
  CEQA review.
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, July 14, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 6 of 7

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9E.  (continued)

  A staff report was given by Aaron Benjamin, Information Technology Manager. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to provide public comment, the Mayor declared the public comments period
  closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Solanki, to:

  1. Authorize the Mayor to enter into a professional services agreement with
  Government Technology Group (GTG) pursuant to the City’s request for proposal and
  the terms and conditions detailed in said agreement in the amount of $74,685; and

  2. Direct City staff to pursue grant funding opportunities to offset the cost of the
  feasibility study and cost-benefit analysis including, but not limited to, the Local
  Agency Technology Assistance (LATA) described in the associated agenda report for
  this item; and

  3. Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute a Fiscal Year 2022-23 budget
  amendment with a new appropriation of $74,685, for the preparation of the
  feasibility study and cost-benefit analysis relative to the proposed Citywide fiber
  optics master plan as stipulated; and

  4. Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute any project-related change orders
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Solanki, Yokoyama, Barrows, Vo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation.

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or Federal
  legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

  None.

11.  Reports

11A.  Report from City Manager/Executive Director

  An informational update on the status of the City’s 2021-29 Housing Element was given
  by Kristin Aguila, Director of Community Development.
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, July 14, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 7 of 7

11.  Reports (continued)

11B.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Meeting Reports

  Reports were given by Councilmember Johnson, Mayor Pro Tem Barrows, and Mayor Vo.

  CONSENSUS (Johnson): Direct the City Manager to invite and recognize all former
  members of the City’s Let Freedom Ring Committee at the 2023 ceremony which will
  commemorate the Committee’s 50th anniversary.

12.  Closed Session

  None.

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 9:34 p.m. in memory of City of Duarte Councilmember
  Tzeitel Paras-Caracci.

  /s/ Vida Barone
  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary
